versions.changelog: 1.0.3: Narabi runs. The skill text now states what adaptive means here: a daily sentinel outside the tool surface steps an adaptive quantile tracker (Angelopoulos, Barber and Bates 2024) on the attested USDe redemption flow and publishes a replayable timeline at monarkgate.tech/narabi/. The tracker adapts; the gate does not yet. Fleet register: four agents built, seven named. No tool surface change: attest, gate, cascade, calibrate.

v0.3.0 alignment: Narabi stable-run-velocity-24h now carries a committed calibration for one population (USDe); every other population abstains under_calib; not yet served by the public endpoint. Mirror URL corrected to per-tool REST paths (api.monarkgate.tech/{attest|gate|cascade|calibrate}).
Refresh demo trace digest; align docs with open-source release
Initial public release: coverage-controlled gate (attest, gate, cascade, calibrate) + BYO calibrate->gate loop.
